release_notes:
v2.0.27 — maintenance fixes (strict-SQL saves, PHP 8, dashboard)

Maintenance fixes

- Fixed: creating a new IMEI/File service could show "saved successfully" but not actually appear when the database runs in strict SQL mode — integer fields now default correctly so the service always saves.
- Fresh installations now set MariaDB to the application's expected (non-strict) SQL mode, preventing this class of silent save failure on new servers.
- Fixed a PHP 8 fatal on the login reCAPTCHA verification path (an unquoted key caused an "Undefined constant" error when a captcha check failed).
- Fixed: re-queuing an order (clearing its supplier order id) now correctly resends it to the supplier on PHP 8.
- Dashboard "Recent Orders" restyled to match the admin theme palette (consistent card, colours, and spacing).
- Hardened the API-threshold utility against direct access so a stray request can't error.
